_doc: Scoped opt-in for bounded auto-remediation. Only safe, reversible or additive classes belong here. Lossy operations (merges, retirements, canon or identity edits) never do; they stay with a human. Set a class enabled:false to hold it, or the top-level enabled:false to freeze every apply (plan still works). sla_days is the breach clock, counted from the finding's first sighting (seeded from file mtime).

drift-debris.desc: Leftover copies (*.bak, *.old, *.orig, *.tmp, *~) and dangling symlinks. Diff against the live file, write the diff to the ledger, then really delete. Restore = the recorded diff re-applied. Only inside owned_roots; other agents' areas are delegated. Binary leftovers that differ are never auto-deleted. Set no_counterpart_action to human to hold orphans.

defer.queue.md: held: a live writer owns this file

stray-root.desc: A loose file at the governing agent's root is moved into the folder named by its own domain: + type: frontmatter. The folder must already exist; a file that doesn't say where it belongs goes to a human. Restore = move back.

alarm-dedup.desc: A repeated alarm in the drift backlog or the governing inbox is collapsed into one line per distinct alarm with first seen / last seen / age / sighting count. Numbers are blanked when fingerprinting. Restore = patch -R with the recorded diff.

frontmatter-stamp.desc: Example command class: wrap an additive engine you already trust. {limit} is substituted from this policy.

never_auto: another agent's files: delegated to the owner, never fixed on their behalf
a finding being OLD is never a reason to move it out of this list
